changes.initial_review: Added include and setup hardware log call observe EQUIP_FLAG after original sas_loadw; no contribution to original setAX result.
changes.counter_review: Provider reads trace-path environment and writes a bounded file stream, preserving last error. Removing this caller cannot change the BIOS equipment word or AX calculation; do not delete shared provider while other callers remain.
changes.limits: Source proof of diagnostic-only dependence; no runtime test or deletion performed.
changes.change_plan: Delete equipment-only diagnostic include and report call/comment; restore original sas_loadw -> setAX sequence. Remove now-unneeded line carriers only with original logical-line verification. Remove shared provider only after all other callers are separately accounted for.
changes.related_callers: BIOS BOP 11 -> equipment; src/ntvdm-exe/softpc/mvdm_softpc_termination.c::mvdm_softpc_report_setup_hardware_probe; other callsites in keyboard, COM/LPT, tape_io and nt_bop remain independently audited.
changes.verification_required: Compare equipment executable body with original; confirm BOP11 returns SAS EQUIP_FLAG in AX. Rebuild selected owner and run existing equipment/Setup regression; do not count disappearance of diagnostic log as product failure.
